name: task_wait
description: Wait for and collect task_spawn results, including pending tasks' latest live progress/checkpoint snapshots. Timeout or early PARKED returns collected results with tasks still running; retry the same task_ids. Optional structured verification adds a bounded assessment (worker_reported, needs_parent_review); completion is not acceptance. Full verification: task_evidence_read(source="delivered", view="raw", exact task_id), omitting fields/max_chars/cursor.

timeout_secs.description: This call's wait budget in seconds (default 30, max 300). May suspend the parent: use task_status while independent work remains. Expiry neither cancels nor stalls subagents.

wait_policy.description: any (default) returns on the first finisher; all collects every finished result, returning early (PARKED) while any remain running. Retrieve remaining results later.
